notes: A client set to mode "proxy" whose proxy was unusable -- not yet assigned by the pool, deleted, or saved with an empty host -- still went out to the WAN on the ISP's own IP, exactly like a direct client, while the Mode column said "forced through proxy". It is now blocked instead. PPPoE sessions can be ticked and rotated straight from the Internet tab, with an optional per-session auto-rotate timer. The icon is a new original mascot, exported at every web and Android size.
